correctness.rationale: A start in a silent gap of length g escapes capture on a phase set of mean length E[(g-L)_+]. Thus PQ=P-sum_i E[(g_i-L)_+]=A+sum_i H(g_i), also for events long enough to wrap around the circle. Increasing A at fixed n by shortening any gap strictly improves capture, since 1-S(u)>0 for u>0. Full budget leaves A=B-n*h>0 and total gap c+n*h; strict concavity of H gives exactly the equal-gap equality cases, independent of the allocation of active lengths. The derivative of the relaxed numerator is M_h(h+c/x)-h, with M_h(g)=H(g)-(g-h)S(g), M_h'(g)=(g-h)f(g)>0, and limit m, since g*S(g)<=2*integral_(g/2)^g S(u)du tends to zero. This settles strictness at h=m and identifies d_h when h<m. Each adjacent difference has derivative S(h+c/(n+1))-S(h+c/n)>0, limits H(h)-h<0 and m-h, and is strictly decreasing in n at fixed c by strict concavity of the count envelope. This proves the ordered roots and exact adjacency ties; the mean-value theorem traps c_n strictly between n*d_h and (n+1)*d_h. The asymptotic uses the same root equation for unbounded mathematical n, independently of the finite feasible prefix at any fixed budget. N=1 and the excluded zero-length count when B/h is integral are consistent. Independent substitution of H=1-exp(-g) and ranking n=1,...,15 reproduces n=5, Q_5=0.7614450862358281 and Q_1=0.7074075836218131 (runner-up n=6 with 0.7609650547093678).
residual_risks: The finite arithmetic example is illustrative. Some frozen checks compare formula implementations against the same algebra rather than independently establishing calculus identities; the analytic proof is decisive. The count relaxation before clipping is on x>0, not a claim that infeasible fractional counts are schedules.

The atomic-rate record proves a full staircase for independent site rotation under a time deadline, with log-failure objective n*phi((H+c)/n-c), phi=-log E[exp(-Lambda*t)], and an all-deadline boundary -log(q)/lambda_0 when there is a positive minimum-rate atom.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The concave-perspective proof architecture overlaps, including neighboring real-count candidates, but the theorem for negative log Laplace transforms of Poisson encounter rates does not apply to a general integrated duration survival function. The role of the feasible prefix and the tail mechanism determining the boundary differ.

value.rationale: The energy constraint makes splitting live time neither free nor always beneficial. An exact all-law cutoff in measurable event-duration units and a global integer choice including ties give a usable design classification, not just a fixed-count balance or numeric comparison. It locates the costs at which experimental scheduling decisions change and separates the count restriction from the timing-law thresholds.
residual_risks: Interprets a partial-overlap capture objective and energy-equivalent overhead only; may not predict field recognizability, wake-up latency or ecological estimator quality.
